data.title: 阿米娅 · 新芽长到了刻度线
data.description: 温室里的苗盆排得很齐。阿米娅蹲下比较嫩叶和木牌上的高度刻度，嘴角一点点扬起来，浇水壶就放在脚边。
data.promptProse: In a Rhodes Island greenhouse, Amiya wears a gray shirt and sage canvas apron. She crouches beside a seedling tray, comparing a new leaf with the height marks on a small wooden marker. A watering can rests on the floor nearby; sunlight passes through the glass roof onto the plants.
data.animaCaption: The measurement marks are simple lines, with no written labels required.
data.action: 蹲下比较新叶与木牌的高度刻度
